svg.title: Packing results · 1–100 squares
svg.desc: Green cells mark proved optima. Amber cells mark nontrivial bounds. White cells mark basic grid bounds. Every result has a Lean proof.

g.text: Green: proved optimal · Amber: nontrivial bound · White: basic grid bound
